evidence.detail: preaggregate_archetype_playability uses _archetype_card_count and _card_count (all-time totals) for its playability ratio
preaggregate_season_archetype_playability uses _season_archetype_card_count and _season_card_count (per-season totals) — deliberate asymmetry but the question is whether it's the right design

triage.notes: Already labelled 'question' by the author. The discrepancy is real code but the right resolution is an owner decision about whether all-time vs season-scoped is the correct denominator for archetype playability.
